arguments.summary: A Cobalt Strike beacon was detected on workstation WS-FIN-042 (IP: 10.0.5.42), originating from user CORP\jsmith. The malicious activity began with a suspicious rundll32 execution at 02:15 UTC, followed by C2 beaconing to an external IP (198.51.100.23) at 02:17 UTC. Initial detection was delayed due to misattribution of source IP (10.0.5.14 vs actual 10.0.5.42).
